name: gradient-fabled-sunset

frames.best_why: Frame 1 shows the whole panel with the darkest violet corner and the brightest pink corner both intact.

tagline: Indigo darkness warms into a vivid pink glow on the right.
summary: A static gradient moving from a very dark indigo-violet on the left through deep royal purple and finishing in a strong hot pink on the right, carried in a wide rounded panel.
appearance: A wide rounded rectangle on a black stage. The left end is a very dark blue-violet, the centre is a deep royal purple, and the right end brightens into a saturated hot pink, blended on a shallow diagonal.
behaviour: Static: nothing animates or reacts; the same dark-to-pink sweep appears in each frame.
search_phrases: gradient for a音乐的 hero section
dark grad back with pink glow
indigo to hot pink color sweep
use_when: A dark, moody sweep with a pink accent suits a night-mode landing or event page.
avoid_when: Both ends are quite dark and hardcoded, so overlaid text needs its own contrast work.
customise: className and style set the size or replace the paint; the indigo, purple and pink stops are hardcoded in the file.
weight_why: One div with one CSS gradient and no runtime work.

a11y.note: Pure decoration with nothing interactive, so no accessibility affordances are needed.

issues: Packet claims a full-bleed footprint while the frames show a rounded card with margins.
polish_why: Smooth, rich blend and clean corners; still a simple static swatch.
title: Fabled Sunset
